title: Sprint 1 - The To-Do List (React Fundamentals)
description: Build a fully functional, controlled To-Do List from scratch while learning Component structure and Hooks.

tickets.title: Component Skeleton
tickets.description: Build a static `TaskItem` component that receives `task` object props.
tasks: Build a static `TaskItem` component that receives `task` object props.
learning_objectives: JSX fundamentals, component extraction, and passing props.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader checks for `function TaskItem(props)`, `<input type="checkbox">`, and `task.text` in the JSX.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: Task List State
tickets.description: Introduce `useState` and controlled inputs to add new tasks.
tasks: Introduce `useState` and controlled inputs to add new tasks.
learning_objectives: State arrays, controlled forms (`value` + `onChange`), and mapping lists.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader checks for `useState`, `<form onSubmit>`, `<input onChange>`, and `array.map`.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: Task Actions (Prop Drilling)
tickets.description: Pass callback functions down to the `TaskItem` to toggle completion or delete tasks.
tasks: Pass callback functions down to the `TaskItem` to toggle completion or delete tasks.
learning_objectives: Event bubbling, Array `filter()`, and Prop Drilling limitations.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader checks for `onToggle`, `onDelete`, array `.map`, and array `.filter`.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: Data Persistence
tickets.description: Save the list to `localStorage` so it survives refresh.
tasks: Save the list to `localStorage` so it survives refresh.
learning_objectives: The `useEffect` lifecycle hook and side effects.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader specifically looks for `useEffect`, `localStorage.getItem`, and `localStorage.setItem`.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the dependency array and causing an infinite loop.
hints: Make sure to clean up any subscriptions if needed.

tickets.title: Dashboard Routing
tickets.description: Build conditional views (List View vs Dashboard View).
tasks: Build conditional views (List View vs Dashboard View).
learning_objectives: Conditional rendering and client-side routing concepts.
tickets.evaluation: Visual Grader ensures the dashboard layout matches the target. Logic Grader checks for ternary operators (`=== ?`).
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.
